subject.title: feat(plugins): expose requester context to tool hooks

question: Should optional host-derived requester identity become a supported public `before_tool_call` plugin API for deployment-local authorization policy, including the Codex native-hook relay?
rationale: The patch is deliberately adding a durable plugin authorization surface, and code review cannot choose its long-term compatibility and ownership contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the additive requester contract
options.body: Merge the narrow API with the documented fail-closed treatment of absent fields and preserve managed/Codex propagation parity.

options.title: Keep identity owner-private
options.body: Do not publish requester facts through the generic hook API; retain any future authorization behavior within an owner-specific implementation until a broader SDK contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt the additive requester contract
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow API with the documented fail-closed treatment of absent fields and preserve managed/Codex propagation parity.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history context identifies this person as the author of both the predecessor design exploration and the narrowed successor proposal.
